title: Zinc-encapsulating covalent organic frameworks for enhanced chemiresistive NH3 sensing at room temperature
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16708-16723
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01430A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sujith Benarzee Nallamalla, Naresh Kumar Katari, A. Jagan Mohan Reddy, Sreekantha Babu Jonnalagadda, Surendra Babu Manabolu Surya
A Zn-encapsulating COF sensor (Zn@COF-3) fabricated via a drop-casting method demonstrates a selective and rapid chemiresistive response to NH3 gas at room temperature, making it suitable for real-time gas sensor applications.
